Beacon collision, camera edges and warm-field verification (2026-10-30)

Tracking and acceptance
- #139 (eliasstepanik): human confirmed solved; confirmation recorded locally and GitHub closed as completed.
- #143 / BUG-025 (Kittingsl): implemented and verified, IN PROGRESS / awaiting human confirmation.
  Physical capsule follows the authored 92x44px rounded ground footprint at the actual displayed Beacon anchor.
  Walking, escape sprint and dodging cannot cross the base; player slides along it.
  Interaction works from all four sides; debug teleport and leaving noclip resolve to safe positions.
- #141 / BUG-024 (Kittingsl): implemented and verified, IN PROGRESS / awaiting human confirmation.
  Camera follows at all edges/corners without viewport/map clamping.
  Existing radius-bounded invisible player boundary works in normal movement and noclip.
- #175 / BUG-030 (Kittingsl): newly recorded report, implemented and verified, IN PROGRESS / awaiting human confirmation.
  Old draft renderer intentionally selected only even (x+y) floor tiles for radial warm spots: the checkerboard source.
  All reachable floor source cells now use distance-weighted alpha; walls/unreachable cells remain zero.
  One cached source texel per tile, linearly interpolated for this faint ambient pass only; sprites/motes remain crisp.
  Resource registry retains one reusable canvas, keyed by guide-field identity and module revision.
  Broader floor-texture blending acceptance in #112 is NOT claimed complete or closed here.
